organization: Prota Mühendislik Proje ve Danışmanlık Hizmetleri A.Ş.
identified_problem: Turkey’s 2021 and 2024 wildfires and the 2021 Black Sea floods damaged built assets and infrastructure corridors. Prota is a major Turkish engineering and design consultancy working on buildings, transportation, energy and industrial projects nationwide, so its project sites and client portfolios are exposed to flood and wildfire hazards.
climate_exposure: Project portfolios located in floodplains, coastal river basins and forested/wildfire-prone zones face increased design loads, construction delays and potential damage to completed assets.
potential_pain: Clients increasingly require climate-risk inputs in feasibility studies and designs; failure to account for intensifying hazards creates liability exposure, cost overruns and reputational risk.
evidence: Talaix historical event intelligence for Turkey’s 2021 Black Sea floods and recent wildfire seasons, plus location-specific flood and wildfire risk layers.
relevant_capability: Talaix hazard, exposure and loss analytics for engineering and infrastructure planning.
recommended_message: Add verified flood and wildfire risk intelligence to Prota’s engineering and feasibility studies across Turkey.
fit_score: Good fit: a leading national engineering consultancy with a broad project portfolio; climate-risk data can strengthen bids, design standards and client advice.

interactions.summary: Identified via official-source research; signal: Prota lists Turkish offices in Ankara, Istanbul and Izmir and provides engineering, architectural and consultancy services in more than 30 countries.
